en.title: Reverence that grew into worship
en.intro: Early Christians honored the martyrs. Over time, that respect grew into a devotion that became worship.

points.label: AT FIRST
points.text: Respect was shown to the remains of the martyrs.

points.label: IT GREW
points.text: The respect became superstitious reverence, and people made pilgrimages to the martyrs’ tombs.

points.label: SCRIPTURE
points.text: The Savior taught us to pray to the Father in His name.

fr.title: Le respect devenu adoration
fr.intro: Les premiers chrétiens honoraient les martyrs. Avec le temps, ce respect est devenu une dévotion qui est devenue de l’adoration.

points.label: AU DÉBUT
points.text: On témoignait du respect aux restes des martyrs.

points.label: IL A GRANDI
points.text: Ce respect est devenu une vénération superstitieuse, et l’on faisait des pèlerinages aux tombeaux des martyrs.

points.label: L’ÉCRITURE
points.text: Le Sauveur nous a appris à prier le Père en son nom.
